Why won't a dog move off a nail? Because moving hurts more.

Kevin Trudeau tells a story about a man having tea on a Southern porch. An old hound dog keeps groaning as it lies on a nail, and the man asks why it won't just move. The answer: it doesn't hurt enough yet.

Kevin says change often starts the same way. You have to get truly fed up with something before you act, because a nail that is painful enough gets you moving.

What is the nail you keep lying on?
